newsitem.title: USA: United matching half-price child air fare.
newsitem.headline: United matching half-price child air fare.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said Wednesday it is matching American Airlines' 50 percent fare discount for children under two years of age who are traveling with an adult.
United said the fare will apply for children under the age of two who occupy their own airplane seat.
"It is designed to encourage the use of child restraint safety seats," UAL spokesman Joe Hopkins said.
Earlier, American, a unit of AMR Corp, said its half-priced fare for children under the age of two is good on U.S. domestic and U.S.-Canadian flights.
Formerly, parents would hold children under the age of two on their laps, a practice that has been found to be dangerous, an American Airlines official said.
